name: Quad Cities SVI Census Tracts
description: The 86 census tracts of Scott County, Iowa and Rock Island and Henry Counties, Illinois that meet SCOUT's Quad Cities flood grid (-90.6879, 41.4150 to -90.4252, 41.6242), from CDC/ATSDR's Social Vulnerability Index 2020 (ArcGIS Hub item 3827cb5593174c79b35119611299279b, tracts layer). CDC's column names: estimates such as E_TOTPOP (people), E_AGE65, E_DISABL, E_NOVEH and E_POV150, and the percentile rankings RPL_THEME1 to 4 and RPL_THEMES (overall); -999 marks a missing value, as CDC publishes it. CDC/ATSDR, public domain.
